theater: 加丹加高原伊利莎白維爾

battle.name: 剛果危機
battle.theater: 加丹加高原伊利莎白維爾
battle.brief: 剛果獨立即引爆軍隊叛變，比利時與法國先後出兵干預，加丹加宣布脫離，聯合國部隊介入南部高原。1960至1964年間美軍以「摩西烏蘇」行動進駐，金沙薩與加丹加高地在車隊、機場與山道之間反覆爭奪；美軍標準配發的M14自動步槍正是在這些護衛與搜索任務中投入實戰。

kit.name: M14自動步槍
kit.history: M14自動步槍是美軍在冷戰期間採用的標準步槍，取代M1伽蘭德，發射7.62×51mm北約彈，具備半自動與全自動射擊模式，並被多國軍隊採用。

countries: 1960年6月30日，剛果共和國脫離比利時統治，成為那年非洲獨立潮中最引人注目的案例。交戰的一方是中央政府：總統約瑟夫·卡薩-武布與首都金沙薩（原名萊奧波德維爾）的軍方，軍隊實權初期握於中校若瑟-德西雷·莫布圖手中，總理帕特里斯·盧蒙巴領導的剛果民族運動黨主張聯邦制，並尋求蘇聯與中國的軍火與顧問支持。另一方是脫離派：加丹加省長莫伊塞·尚貝於1960年7月11日宣布成立加丹加自治國，以伊利莎白維爾（今盧本巴希）為首都，掌控南部高原的銅鈷礦帶，倚賴比利時殖民時期留下來的加丹加警衛隊、武裝警察，以及歐洲與南部非洲的傭兵。比利時自1960年7月以「東方地」行動出兵，護僑並保護礦業設施；法國在1961年8月與9月以「禿鷹」及「猛擊」兩度空降介入，站在加丹加一方作戰。聯合國安理會在1960年8月與11月連續決議提供援助，並授權建立聯合國剛果部隊，分遣隊來自加納、衣索比亞、愛爾蘭、瑞典、烏拉圭、加拿大、印度、巴基斯坦等國，總兵力最高時接近兩萬人。1964年之後形勢再變：莫伊塞·尚貝被召回主持政府，討伐東部起義的美國所支持的「辛巴」叛軍，比利時與法國以軍事顧問與傭兵名義再度介入；蘇聯與中國的援助方向則由盧蒙巴轉向加丹加，再轉回金沙薩，武器與顧問的流向幾度逆轉，構成冷戰時期典型的代理戰線。
countriesEn: The Congo Crisis unfolded across four distinct layers of belligerency. The Republic of the Congo gained independence from Belgium on 30 June 1960, in what became the single most striking case of that remarkable year of African independence. On one side stood the central government: President Joseph Kasa-Vubu and the military in the capital, Léopoldville (now Kinshasa), where real power inside the army initially rested with Lieutenant-Colonel Joseph-Désiré Mobutu. Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba, leader of the Mouvement National Congolais, advocated a federal structure and sought weapons and advisers from the Soviet Union and China. On the other side stood the secessionists: Moïse Tshombe, governor of Katanga, proclaimed the Autonomous State of Katanga on 11 July 1960, made Élisabethville (today Lubumbashi) his capital, and controlled the copper and cobalt belt of the southern plateau, relying on the Katangese gendarmerie, the armed police inherited from the colonial period, and on mercenaries from Europe and southern Africa. Belgium deployed troops from July 1960 under Operation Oosterland to protect its nationals and the mining installations; France intervened twice by airborne assault, in August and September 1961, under Operations Vautour and Rumpunch, and fought on the Katangese side. The United Nations Security Council resolved in August and November 1960 to provide assistance and authorised the United Nations Congo force, with contingents drawn from Ghana, Ethiopia, Ireland, Sweden, Uruguay, Canada, India, Pakistan and other states, approaching twenty thousand men at its peak. After 1964 the alignment inverted once more: Tshombe was recalled from exile to head a government that fought the Simba revolt in the east with American backing, while Belgium and France intervened again through military advisers and mercenaries; Soviet and Chinese aid swung from Lumumba to Katanga and then back to Kinshasa, the flow of arms and advisers reversing several times and forming a classic Cold War proxy line.
people: 關鍵人物集中在非洲與歐洲兩端。剛果方面，總理帕特里斯·盧蒙巴在1960年6月組閣，是全國主義與聯邦制的主張者，7月叛變之後向蘇聯與中國求援，同年9月被解職並遭軟禁，1961年1月移交加丹加方面後遭殺害，官方與民間對其死亡日期與方式至今仍有爭議。總統約瑟夫·卡薩-武布主張聯邦並與盧蒙巴爭奪權力；軍方首腦若瑟-德西雷·莫布圖於9月24日以政變驅逐蘇聯顧問，其後數度改組政府，1965年11月再以第二次政變掌握全部權力。加丹加方面，莫伊塞·尚貝是分離主義的象徵人物，1961年被任命為加丹加總理，1964年自流亡地召回組閣並兼任國防部長；法國退伍軍人羅歇·特里尼耶一度出任加丹加警衛隊總指揮，比利時人讓·施拉姆、讓·德納爾與英國人麥克·霍爾先後率領傭兵作戰，華裔的克里斯多夫·姆萬加是辛巴叛軍中最具知名度的人物之一，安東·吉曾加則在斯坦利維爾組織「自由剛果」政府。聯合國方面，秘書長達格·哈馬斯約爾德拒絕讓部隊協助中央政府對付脫離派，1961年9月18日其座機在北羅德西亞恩多拉墜毀身亡，事後由緬甸的尤·丹特代理職務。美軍方面，第11空降師與第82空降師各派出營級分遣隊，第505步槍團、187空降步兵營是最初抵達的骨幹；1964年之後的美國支援則由中情局在幕後運作，僱用古巴流亡飛行員執行空投與空運任務。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities stood at two ends of the spectrum, in Africa and in Europe. On the Congolese side, Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba took office in June 1960 as the champion of Congolese nationalism and of federalism; after the mutiny of July he turned to the Soviet Union and China for arms and advisers, was dismissed and placed under guard in September 1960, and in January 1961 was handed over to the Katangese, where he was killed, the official date and manner of his death remaining disputed. President Joseph Kasa-Vubu favoured a federation and fought Lumumba for authority, while the army chief Joseph-Désiré Mobutu broke the deadlock with a coup on 24 September that expelled the Soviet advisers, reorganised the government several times, and culminated in a second coup in November 1965 that left him master of the country. In Katanga, Moïse Tshombe became the emblem of secession, was made prime minister of Katanga in 1961, and returned from exile in 1964 to head the government and the ministry of defence; the French veteran Roger Trinquier briefly commanded the Katangese gendarmerie, while Jean Schramme, Jean Denard and the Irishman Mike Hoare led mercenary formations in turn. Christophe Mwanza, of Chinese descent, was among the best known Simba leaders, and Antoine Gizenga organised the Free Republic government at Stanleyville. On the United Nations side, Secretary-General Dag Hammarskjöld refused to use his troops against the secessionists on behalf of the central government, and on 18 September 1961 his aircraft crashed at Ndola in Northern Rhodesia, killing him, after which U Thant of Burma served as acting Secretary-General. The American presence was formed by battalion detachments of the 11th Airborne Division and the 82nd Airborne Division, with the 505th Infantry Regiment and the 187th Airborne Infantry among the first units to arrive; from 1964 onward American support was directed covertly by the Central Intelligence Agency, which employed Cuban exile pilots for the airlift and resupply missions.
kits: 卡面這件M14自動步槍，正是1960至1961年間美軍在剛果的標準步兵武器。M14於1959年列裝，取代二戰後的M1伽蘭德，發射7.62×51毫米北約彈，配20發彈匣，具半自動與全自動兩種射擊模式，標稱有效射程約六百公尺，全槍重約四公斤，是當時精度與射程最好的一代通用步槍；缺點是槍身重、後坐力大，換裝在部隊中並未一次到位，許多美軍分遣隊在剛果仍同時攜帶M1伽蘭德與M1卡賓槍，到1964年M16才開始少量裝備、1965年才在前線大量使用，因此M14是美軍在剛果這幾年唯一穩定可靠的主力步槍。同時在場的還有大量歐洲武器：比利時與加丹加警衛隊使用FN FAL步槍，同樣發射7.62×51毫米北約彈，與M14在彈藥上前線互通，這是西方介入陣營內部最實際的一條技術紐帶；法軍傘兵同樣以FAL為主，通用機槍為FN MAG與Browning機槍，並配備六十與八十一公厘迫擊砲。中國與蘇聯向盧蒙巴一方及後來的加丹加供應的則是7.62×39毫米AK-47步槍、PPSh-41衝鋒槍、DP輕機槍與RPG-2、RPG-7火箭筒，彈藥口徑與西方不同，後勤上需自成體系。車輛方面以Land Rover越野車、載重卡車與吉普車為主，空中力量包括法軍的B-26轟炸機與Alouette武裝直升機，比利時的T-6螺旋槳機與C-47運輸機，聯合國的瑞典F22分遣隊以Saab 105戰鬥機執行對地攻擊，各方均以伊利莎白維爾與金沙薩的機場作為補給與傷員後送的樞紐。
kitsEn: The M14 automatic rifle shown on the card face was precisely the standard infantry weapon of the American forces in the Congo between 1960 and 1961. Adopted in 1959, the M14 replaced the Second World War M1 Garand and fires the 7.62×51mm NATO cartridge from a twenty-round magazine in both semi-automatic and fully automatic modes, with a rated effective range of about six hundred metres and a weight of roughly four kilograms; it was the most accurate and longest-ranged general service rifle of its generation, though heavy to carry and hard-hitting, and the re-equipping of units was never completed at once, so many American detachments in the Congo carried the M1 Garand and the M1 Carbine alongside it, while the M16 was only issued in small numbers from 1964 and in bulk on the front line from 1965, which leaves the M14 as the one dependable main rifle available to American troops in the Congo in those years. Alongside it stood a great deal of European equipment: the Belgian and Katangese gendarmerie used the FN FAL, also firing the 7.62×51mm NATO round, so that ammunition was interchangeable at the front line between the M14 and the FAL, the most practical technical link binding the Western intervention; French paratroopers were likewise armed mainly with the FAL, supported by FN MAG and Browning machine guns and by 60mm and 81mm mortars. The arms delivered by China and the Soviet Union, first to Lumumba and later to Katanga, were of a different standard, the 7.62×39mm AK-47, the PPSh-41, the DP light machine gun and the RPG-2 and RPG-7 launchers, whose ammunition did not match the Western rounds and therefore formed a separate logistic system. Transport consisted chiefly of Land Rovers, lorries and jeeps, while air power included French B-26 bombers and Alouette armed helicopters, Belgian T-6 propeller aircraft and C-47 transports, and the Swedish F22 detachment operating Saab 105 fighters in a ground attack role; every camp used the airfields of Élisabethville and Kinshasa as the pivots of supply and of the evacuation of the wounded.
tactics: 加丹加方面以殖民時期的警衛隊與武裝警察為骨幹，戰術是車載游擊與縱隊突進：車隊沿金沙薩至伊利莎白維爾的主要公路推進，在卡米納、賈多維爾、科爾韋茲一帶路段設伏，用FN MAG與Browning通用機槍封鎖路口，再以小分隊徒步滲入，控制水壩、礦場與橋樑。城市防衛依託礦業公司的圍牆、水塔與廠房，逐層設置射擊孔，抵禦傘兵與空降部隊。聯合國部隊在1961年後改採正面推進：先以武裝直升機與瑞典F22的Saab 105對地攻擊削弱陣地，再由加納、愛爾蘭與衣索比亞的分遣隊沿公路縱進，配合裝甲車與卡車封鎖退路，奪取交通線與行政中心。法國「禿鷹」與「猛擊」行動則完全以空降突襲為核心，傘兵落地即攻佔城鎮與機場，仰賴地面部隊迅速鞏固，顯示歐洲部隊在1961年仍具備快速反應能力。美軍在「摩西烏蘇」行動下的部署較為保守，重點是護衛伊利莎白維爾與金沙薩的機場、護送補給車隊、保護聯合國與人道物資，同時用M14的精確射擊在巡邏與遭遇戰中壓制分散的游擊隊。1964年之後的辛巴戰役則完全是另一種樣態：叛軍以叢林伏擊與夜間突襲困擾東路重鎮，政府軍與傭兵靠外線空投與小型運輸機逐點補給，經典戰法是沿公路搜索推進、以直升機與武裝空降隊封鎖河谷，最終在斯坦利維爾、烏維拉與布尼亞一線逐個奪回城鎮。
tacticsEn: Katanga built its tactics on the gendarmerie and the armed police inherited from the colonial period, favouring mounted guerrilla action and columns on the move: vehicle columns advanced along the main road from Kinshasa to Élisabethville, laying ambushes in the sectors of Kamina, Jadotville and Kolwezi, sealing the junctions with FN MAG and Browning general purpose machine guns, and then pushing infantry patrols on foot into the valleys to seize dams, mines and bridges. The defence of the towns relied on the perimeter walls, water towers and workshops of the mining companies, layer upon layer of firing positions, and was meant to hold against parachute and airborne assault. After 1961 the United Nations changed to a deliberate advance: first the armed helicopters and the Saab 105s of the Swedish F22 knocked out positions, then Ghanaian, Irish and Ethiopian detachments pushed forward along the roads, with armoured cars and trucks sealing the retreat, taking the lines of communication and the administrative centres. The French Operations Vautour and Rumpunch were built entirely on airborne assault, paratroopers seizing towns and airfields on landing and relying on ground troops to consolidate quickly, which showed that European forces in 1961 still retained the capacity for a rapid reaction. American deployment under Operation Mose Ussu was more cautious, centred on guarding the airfields of Élisabethville and Kinshasa, escorting supply convoys and protecting United Nations and relief stores, while the accurate fire of the M14 was used on patrols and in contact to pin down scattered guerrillas. The Simba war of 1964 and 1965 took a quite different form: the insurgents used ambushes in the forest and night attacks to harass the eastern towns, while government troops and mercenaries were supplied by air drops and small transport aircraft on the outside of the map, working up along the roads with helicopters and airborne troops sealing the river valleys, and finally retaking Stanleyville, Uvira and Bunia one by one.
data: 可查考的數字集中在幾個節點上。剛果於1960年6月30日獨立，加丹加於7月11日宣布脫離；比利時「東方地」行動在1960年7月出動，參與兵力在文獻中常以一萬人上下計，其中相當一部分駐紮在南部礦區。美軍第一批分遣隊於1960年8月初抵達金沙薩，1961年高峰期的駐剛兵力維持在數千人規模，主要來自第11空降師與第82空降師的營級分遣隊。聯合國安理會在1960年8月請求提供援助、11月通過第157號決議授權建立聯合國部隊，各國分遣隊合計最高時接近兩萬人，人數最多的包括加納、衣索比亞、愛爾蘭與瑞典等分遣隊。法國在1961年8月的「禿鷹」行動投入逾五千名傘兵與海軍陸戰隊，先後奪取賈多維爾與科爾韋茲；同年9月法軍在「猛擊」行動中重返伊利莎白維爾，聯合國部隊在月底前後分批撤出，而8月31日通過的安理會第199號決議即要求比利時與法國撤軍。哈馬斯約爾德的座機於1961年9月18日在恩多拉墜毀。1964至1965年的辛巴戰役中，叛軍曾控制東部大片地區並在斯坦利維爾另立政權，其作戰骨幹人數以數千計；西方傭兵規模在1964年後增至數千人，1961年時則只有數百人。M14的技術參數為7.62×51毫米北約彈、20發彈匣、標稱有效射程約六百公尺、全自動射速每分鐘約七百至八百發、全槍重約四公斤。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around a few dates. The Congo became independent on 30 June 1960 and Katanga declared its secession on 11 July; Operation Oosterland, launched by Belgium in July 1960, is usually reckoned in the literature at around ten thousand men, a substantial part of them stationed in the southern mining districts. The first American detachments landed at Kinshasa in early August 1960, and the American strength in the Congo remained in the low thousands at its 1961 peak, drawn mainly from battalion detachments of the 11th and 82nd Airborne Divisions. The Security Council called for assistance in August 1960 and adopted Resolution 157 in November authorising the United Nations force, whose contingents together approached twenty thousand men at their highest, the largest being those of Ghana, Ethiopia, Ireland and Sweden. Operation Vautour in August 1961 committed more than five thousand French paratroopers and marines, who took Jadotville and then Kolwezi; in September the French returned to Élisabethville under Operation Rumpunch and the United Nations withdrew in stages around the end of the month, Resolution 199 of 31 August having called on Belgium and France to withdraw. Hammarskjöld's aircraft crashed at Ndola on 18 September 1961. In the Simba war of 1964 and 1965 the insurgents held large parts of the east and set up their own authority at Stanleyville, with a fighting core numbered in the thousands; the Western mercenary contingent grew to several thousand men after 1964, against only a few hundred in 1961. The technical figures of the M14 are the 7.62×51mm NATO cartridge, a twenty-round magazine, a rated effective range of about six hundred metres, a rate of fire in automatic mode of roughly seven hundred to eight hundred rounds per minute, and a weight of about four kilograms.
cause: 危機的根源在於殖民體制在毫無預備的情況下被連根拔起。1945至1960年間，剛果的城市化、工礦開發與受教人口增長極快，但所有權、行政權與軍事指揮權仍操在數百名比利時官員與傳教士手中，剛果本地精英在議會中失去實際影響力；1959年路易斯堡大學事件引發全國性的政治危機，說明首都以外的地區並不承認中央的權威。聯邦問題從未真正解決：加丹加與南卡塞主張以省為單位組成聯邦甚至採邦聯形式，剛果民族運動黨則主張中央集權，兩套方案背後都附帶著對銅鈷礦收益的控制，Union Minière du Haut-Katanga 的分紅與 Formulaire spécial 購買機制的爭議，於是把政治分歧變成利益分配問題。獨立當日的波杜安王子在金沙薩的演說，被剛果人視為對新政權的輕蔑，直接引爆1960年7月的軍隊叛變與城鎮騷亂：士兵長期低薪、裝備不足，軍中混編比利時與剛果軍官，叛變迅速蔓延到赤道省與伊利莎白維爾，國家的強制力在數週之內名存實亡。比利時以護僑名義出兵，法國與比利時在背後支持加丹加的企業與地方精英，而美國與蘇聯各以情報、資金與武器介入其中，於是原本的憲政爭議被推成了國際代理戰爭。
causeEn: The crisis had its roots in a colonial structure torn out without preparation. Between 1945 and 1960 the Congo urbanised, industrialised and educated its population faster than any other colony, yet ownership, administrative authority and command remained in the hands of a few hundred Belgian officials and missionaries, and the local elite lost real influence in the assemblies; the Lovanium University affair of 1959 raised a political crisis across the country, showing that the capital's authority was not accepted outside it. The federal question was never really settled: Katanga and South Kasai argued for provinces grouped into a federation, even a confederal arrangement, while the Mouvement National Congolais stood for a centralised state, and behind both positions lay control of the revenue from copper and cobalt, so that the dispute over dividends and the special purchase form of the Union Minière du Haut-Katanga turned a constitutional disagreement into a quarrel over money. The speech delivered at Kinshasa by Prince Baudouin on the day of independence was heard by the Congolese as an insult to the new authority, and it detonated the mutiny of the army and the urban unrest of July 1960: soldiers were long underpaid and ill-equipped, the officer corps mixed Belgian and Congolese men, and the mutiny spread within weeks to the Équateur province and to Élisabethville, destroying the coercive power of the state. Belgium intervened in the name of protecting its nationals, France and Belgium supported the Katangese companies and local notables behind the scenes, and the United States and the Soviet Union entered with intelligence, money and arms, so that a constitutional quarrel was pushed into an international proxy war.
impact: 剛果危機的第一重後果，是剛果共和國作為一個國家方案的失敗。聯邦問題懸而未決，盧蒙巴之死使民族主義者對西方與聯合國的信任徹底崩塌，軍隊在往後數年裡反覆政變：1965年11月莫布圖的第二次政變、1967年的再度奪權與對西歐物質援助的拒絕、1971年的改名與「真實性」運動，都延續了危機期間形成的、以軍隊取代政黨的權力結構，直到1997年才告崩解。對非洲而言，危機是去殖民化的一次沉重教訓：1960年一年之內有十七個非洲國家宣告獨立，1963年非洲統一組織在亞的斯亞貝巴成立；但剛果的經驗也讓新獨立的國家意識到，軍隊、礦產收益與排除外來干涉三件事必須自己握在手中。對聯合國而言，1960至1961年的剛果行動是一次嚴重挫敗：部隊不願協助中央政府對付脫離派，指揮體系與經費籌措混亂，哈馬斯約爾德身亡，安理會被迫在1961年之後把姿態由宣稱中立轉為明確支持中央政府，早期維和行動與主權之間的模糊地帶由此暴露。對冷戰格局而言，剛果是代理戰爭、傭兵作戰與中情局隱蔽介入相結合的早期樣板，幾乎所有日後在非洲出現的介入模式，都能在這五年裡找到雛形。
impactEn: The first consequence of the Congo Crisis was the failure of the Congo as a state project. The federal question remained unresolved, Lumumba's death destroyed all trust in the West and in the United Nations, and the army staged coup after coup: Mobutu's second coup of November 1965, his seizure of power again in 1967 with the rejection of Western material aid, and the renaming of the country together with the authenticity campaign of 1971, all perpetuated the pattern formed during the crisis, in which the army replaced the parties as the source of power, a pattern that would last until 1997. For Africa the crisis was a bitter lesson in decolonisation: seventeen African countries declared independence in the single year 1960 and the Organisation of African Unity was founded at Addis Ababa in 1963, but the Congo experience taught the newly independent states that the army, the revenue from minerals and the exclusion of foreign interference were three things that had to be held in their own hands. For the United Nations, the Congo operation of 1960 and 1961 was a serious failure: the troops would not help the central government against the secessionists, command and financing were in confusion, Hammarskjöld was killed, and the Security Council was obliged after 1961 to shift from declared neutrality to open support for the central government, exposing the ambiguity between peacekeeping and sovereignty. For the Cold War order, the Congo was an early model combining proxy war, mercenary combat and covert Central Intelligence Agency involvement, and almost every form of later African intervention can be traced in outline to those five years.
result: 結果分三段落定。1960至1961年，中央政府節節退讓：盧蒙巴被解職、軟禁並於1961年1月移交加丹加方面後遇害，聯合國部隊被限制在保衛金沙薩與保障人身安全的範圍內；加丹加與南卡塞在比利時、法國與外部援助之下維持了相當長時間的事實獨立，其間兩度出現聯合國部隊同加丹加警衛隊的正面交火，法國更以「禿鷹」與「猛擊」兩次空降把聯合國逼出加丹加，直到1961年8月安理會第199號決議之後，支持中央國家的態勢才逐漸扭轉。1962年南卡塞政府垮台，1963年1月聯合國部隊解除加丹加武裝，尚貝流亡國外，此時聯合國已改為支持金沙薩對南部高原的接管。1964年尚貝被召回出任總理兼國防部長，美國與比利時以傭兵、情報與空中支援介入，東部的辛巴叛軍在斯坦利維爾、烏維拉與布尼亞一線相繼崩解；1964年6月聯合國部隊全部撤出，1965年11月莫布圖第二次政變之後，危機以軍事獨裁的形式收場，加丹加的自治嘗試與剛果的聯邦理想同時落幕。此後數十年裡，這場危機留給後人的並非一套邊界或制度，而是軍隊干政、代理人戰爭與外來干涉的長久慣性。
resultEn: The outcome settled in three stages. In 1960 and 1961 the central government gave ground at every turn: Lumumba was dismissed, placed under guard and, after being handed over to the Katangese in January 1961, killed; the United Nations force was confined to the defence of Kinshasa and the protection of persons; and Katanga and South Kasai maintained a de facto independence for a considerable time with Belgian, French and outside assistance, including two occasions on which United Nations troops and the Katangese gendarmerie fought each other, while France twice brought the United Nations to the point of retreat from Katanga by airborne assault under Operations Vautour and Rumpunch. Only after Resolution 199 of 31 August 1961 did the balance tip towards the central government. The South Kasai government collapsed in 1962, the United Nations disarmed Katanga in January 1963 and Tshombe went into exile, by which time the United Nations was supporting the takeover of the southern plateau by Kinshasa. Tshombe was recalled in 1964 to be prime minister and minister of defence, the United States and Belgium intervened with mercenaries, intelligence and air support, and the Simba insurgents collapsed in turn at Stanleyville, Uvira and Bunia; the United Nations force withdrew completely in June 1964, and after Mobutu's second coup of November 1965 the crisis closed with military dictatorship, the Katangese experiment and the Congolese federal ideal both abandoned. What the crisis left behind for the decades that followed was not a set of borders or institutions but the durable inertia of military rule, proxy war and foreign intervention.
